strings.i18_INTRO_SSS_JF2_11: An additional 100% of the current play is required as the Extra Play.
strings.i18_INTRO_SSS_JF2_12: Each line win is multiplied by the corresponding reel multiplier.
strings.i18_INTRO_SSS_JF2_14: The number of lines is fixed at 5.
strings.i18_INTRO_SSS_JF2_17: Winning combinations of identical symbols start from the leftmost reel and are counted consecutively from left to right on adjacent reels.
strings.i18_INTRO_SSS_JF2_18: Winning combinations and prizes are determined according to the win table.
strings.i18_INTRO_SSS_JF2_19: Only the highest prize is awarded per line.
strings.i18_INTRO_SSS_JF2_2: Scatter symbol appears on all reels.
strings.i18_INTRO_SSS_JF2_20: All winning combinations on multiple lines are accumulated and included in the total prize.
strings.i18_INTRO_SSS_JF2_21: Bonus games are calculated based on the play amount placed when the feature is triggered.
strings.i18_INTRO_SSS_JF2_22: Objects displayed in the game interface are for visual purposes only and do not affect or reflect the actual winning probability or prizes.
strings.i18_INTRO_SSS_JF2_3: Landing 3, 4, or 5 Scatters awards 10x, 50x, or 250x your current play.
strings.i18_INTRO_SSS_JF2_4: Scatter prizes are awarded independently and are added to any other potential winnings.
strings.i18_INTRO_SSS_JF2_6: Multiplier Reel values are x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, and x10.
strings.i18_INTRO_SSS_JF2_7: With a regular play, a win on second row awards the corresponding multiplier.
strings.i18_INTRO_SSS_JF2_9: Odds are shown based on a total play of {num0}.

note: Paytable amounts multiply the base play directly. Validated against 60 decoded public-trial rounds (30 regular, 30 Extra Play); Scatter protocol details still require a real winning sample.
